audience.programmeDescription: Medicine connects the mechanisms of health and disease with clinical reasoning, physical examination, patient contact, research and medical professional development. This comparison follows the regular 2024 entrant cohort through its three documented years.
audience.comparisonExplanation: This UCR programme provides sustained scientific study of human health and disease, with anatomy, physiology, pathology, pharmacology, infection, neuroscience and health research. These subjects respond directly to Medicine’s scientific foundations. Clinical reasoning levels, physical examination, acute medical skills, assessed patient care and medical professional formation remain substantial gaps; psychology and biomedical laboratory courses do not replace them.

curriculum.limitation: The documented cohort comprises 60, 56 and 64 EC across its three years. Clinical and research minor topics depend on the permitted selection. The ordinary first-year study-advice threshold is 42 EC. RADAr participation is an additional 0-EC requirement; passing it is not required.

componentNotes.y2-research: Required 7-EC scientific research proposal, assessed through a pre-proposal, grant proposal, collaboration and graphical abstract; no separately named bachelor thesis.
componentNotes.y2-elective: 4.5 EC genuinely open elective space, under the programme’s incorporation rules.

alternatives.label: Human health, disease and behaviour
alternatives.concept: Study the scientific basis of human health and disease through anatomy, physiology, molecular pathology, pharmacology, infection, neuroscience, psychology and health research. This is a sustained medical-science response to Medicine’s disease-mechanism and evidence strands. It does not provide the programme’s clinical reasoning and examination sequence, assessed patient care, acute medical skills or physician qualification.
progression: Current workbook prerequisites and all six planned terms pass. Life/biomedicine and brain/behaviour gateways precede their dependent specialist courses. The retained schedule has 24 unique courses, four per term, Year-1 PPD and nine 300-level courses.

notes.text: UCR offers substantial study of disease mechanisms and health evidence. It does not reproduce Medicine’s assessed clinical reasoning, physical examination, patient encounters or professional medical formation. This comparison does not establish admission to a medical master or a qualification to practise medicine.

blocks: Human systems and mechanisms of illness

Medical evidence, innovation and population health

Both investigate population health in a local setting: UCR applies epidemiological evidence to a Zeeland health challenge, while one Radboud integration assignment concerns health in Nijmegen. This covers part of the integrated medical assignments.

Both develop research-method and evidence-appraisal skills. UCR emphasizes experimental design and statistical modelling in health and behavioural research; this is a partial relationship to Radboud’s wider medical context and science strand.
Both critically synthesize evidence for health-related questions. UCR teaches systematic review and meta-analysis; Radboud also assesses evidence-based guidelines and a written examination.
